timing.warning: Two equivalent relative timelines are preserved; original audio scheduling implementation is not inferred here.

normalizationNotes: All original elements and fields are retained in source order.
FollowMids (n) names normalize to kind FollowMids, preserving the original name.
Follow paths preserve authored source order, including any point slightly beyond FollowEnd Z.
Hold endpoints use pos.z - se.y; comma-separated ext tick positions are preserved independently.
updateType/msLeft/mstartPos are retained, not replaced with an invented runtime motion formula.
